dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate; trailing edge exhibits a deep, smooth concave curvature from the apex to the posterior base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex classification with a smooth, non-acute radius of curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep posterior-diagonally leaning anterior margin, approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped chevron scar pattern located on the lower posterior flank near the fin base; numerous white punctate depigmentation spots and micro-scratches distributed across the dark pigment of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced bi-tonal pigmentation gradient with a sharp transition from dark dorsal coloration to light grey ventral/lateral shading.
